meta.title: Taylor Crouch | Full-Stack Software Engineer
meta.description: Tokyo-based full-stack software engineer with 3+ years building production web applications and internal business systems across TypeScript, Vue, Go, Java, PHP, SQL/NoSQL, and AWS.

top.subtitle: Tokyo-based full-stack software engineer with 3+ years of hands-on development, including 2+ years full-time building production web applications and internal business systems in Japan.
top.summary: I work across TypeScript/Vue/Next.js, Go/Gin, Java/Spring MVC, PHP, SQL and NoSQL, and AWS, from authentication, validation, and data-processing workflows through APIs, production debugging, and release. I translate client requirements into scoped technical solutions, lead teams of 2–5 through implementation and release, and support multilingual platforms in real operational environments. English native; Japanese JLPT N3.

experience.intro: Full-time delivery covers production web applications and internal business systems: frontend and backend implementation, databases, AWS, client communication, and small-team coordination through release. Earlier roles add teaching, research, and communication in education settings.

roles.title: Full-stack Web Engineer
highlights: Built and maintained web applications across Vue.js/TypeScript, Go/Gin, Java/Spring MVC, PHP, MySQL, MongoDB, and AWS, working across frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure layers.
Developed and supported Go/Gin and MongoDB business applications with authentication, validation, data-processing workflows, administrative tooling, and production troubleshooting.
Worked directly with clients and internal stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions, define scope, clarify edge cases, and coordinate development through release.
Led teams of 2–5 developers, coordinating implementation, testing, releases, and issue resolution across multiple projects.
Diagnosed and resolved production issues involving application logic, APIs, databases, DNS, and deployment environments.

roles.title: Volunteer Web Developer
highlights: Fixed UI/UX issues and improved responsive behavior across devices.
Supported localization improvements for a multilingual user experience.
Added Cypress end-to-end test coverage and contributed to Django backend updates.
Collaborated remotely with a cross-functional team of 10–15 members.

roles.title: Assistant Language Teacher
highlights: Collaborated with teachers to plan and deliver classes for 30+ students.
Supported curriculum and assessment preparation with a focus on clarity and accuracy.

roles.title: Research Assistant in Physics Education

roles.title: Teaching Assistant for General Physics Labs
highlights: Supported course delivery and instructed students in general physics labs.

mediaLibraryManager.name: Media Library Manager
mediaLibraryManager.description: Built a self-hosted full-stack application for cataloging movies, TV, music, books, and games, with a TypeScript/Vite frontend, Go/Gin REST APIs, JWT authentication, external metadata API integration, barcode-assisted lookup, MongoDB persistence, and S3-compatible object storage.
highlights: TypeScript/Vite frontend with responsive UI for cataloging movies, TV, music, books, and games.
Go/Gin services expose REST APIs with JWT authentication and user-scoped access.
External metadata integration and barcode-assisted lookup for faster cataloging of physical media.
MongoDB persistence and S3-compatible object storage in a self-hosted stack.
